question_text: What would happen to a buck converter if you completely removed the Inductor?
answer_text: A catastrophic short circuit. The MOSFET would likely be destroyed instantly.
explanation_text: The inductor is the only component limiting the rate of current change (di/dt). If you remove it, the high-side switch connects the input voltage directly to the empty output capacitor. This causes an infinite spike of inrush current that will instantly burn out the switch. You should really build this on LTspice to see it in action. An LTspice model will be added in the future if deemed necessary.
